author: Romain Racamier-Lafon <romain.racamier@gmail.com>
description: GING Is Not Gantt, but kind of ツ
name: @shuunen/ging

scripts.build: turbo run build:vite && echo build completed successfully
scripts.build:vite: vite build && echo build:vite completed successfully
scripts.check: turbo run --output-logs=errors-only lint:install lint:types lint:knip lint:format lint:issues lint:repo test:unit build:vite && echo check completed successfully
scripts.lint: turbo run lint:install lint:types lint:knip lint:format lint:issues lint:repo && echo lint completed successfully
scripts.lint:format: oxfmt --check && echo lint:format completed successfully || (echo Please run pnpm run lint:format:fix to format the code && exit 1)
scripts.lint:install: pnpm install && echo lint:install completed successfully
scripts.lint:issues: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives && echo lint:issues completed successfully || (echo Please run pnpm run lint:issues:fix to fix the lint issues && exit 1)
scripts.lint:types: tsc -p tsconfig.json && echo lint:types completed successfully
scripts.test: turbo run test:unit && echo test completed successfully
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --coverage && echo test:unit completed successfully
scripts.test:update: vitest run --update && echo test:update completed successfully
scripts.up:deps: pnpm update --recursive --latest && echo up:deps completed successfully
